stem: A single source-water EC reading is far above the recent trend, while plant and root-zone observations have not changed. What is the strongest immediate response?
choices: Rewrite the nutrient program from the abnormal reading so the crop is protected immediately from the apparent source-water change
Increase irrigation duration to dilute the source-water EC at the root zone before confirming whether the source measurement is repeatable
Assume the crop has adapted to higher salt levels because plant and root-zone observations have remained stable despite the reading
Repeat the measurement with a verified method and compare it with recent source records before making a management change
rationale: An isolated abnormal reading should be verified before driving a management change. Trend comparison and measurement confirmation help distinguish a real source-water change from a measurement problem.
